scope: Host GitHub origin admission and read-only live adapter checks. No OTA candidate was built or admitted from GitHub, no release was published, and no Pi or repository configuration was changed.

checks.name: live-github-adapter

steps: Test CI reports, build identity, and input diagnostic safety
Check default GPU kiosk client (no display required)
Run cargo check --locked -p engine-nes -p scenario-falling -p scenario-nes --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
Run cargo test --locked -p engine-nes -p scenario-falling -p scenario-nes --all-targets
Test recovery profiles and native ground/boarding behavior

verified_boundaries: Trusted workflow hashes and exact required jobs/steps are selected outside candidate artifacts
Current run and explicit attempt endpoints agree on exact main source, repository, workflow, event and successful result
Both source CI and OTA build are independently checked; PR/fork/foreign/stale runs and missing/skipped qualification steps reject
Artifact run/source/repository, exact source-run-attempt name, expiry and producer time window are checked
Artifact ZIP length and SHA-256 match GitHub records before parsing; API bearer token is absent from artifact-host requests
ZIP metadata allocation and expanded member sizes are bounded; traversal, duplicate entries, links, directories, encrypted entries and malformed CRC reject
New run attempts or changed artifact/job identities during download reject before yielding files
Private temporary files are removed on exit and downstream validation failure; origin receipt is not a signing authorization
API JSON and artifact reads recheck session deadline between partial reads; network errors redact signed CDN locations
limitations: This is a library, not a configured OTA build/signing/publication workflow.
The live run covers remote main 1df24f2b574400a7b9ae78145c67402721aae907, not this unpushed OTA branch.
Artifact metadata has no attempt/producer-job identity; name and creation-window checks rely on the reviewed workflow limiting the uploader.
Image format, actual expanded hashes, embedded source/boot/protocol/data identity and complete Yocto provenance still require independent pinned validation.
Workflow hashing does not by itself pin actions/dependencies or prove tests did not suppress command failures.
The unsigned receipt is evidence only; later jobs need fresh authoritative admission and independently approved exact content.
Durable publisher history, current-parent selection, generation allocation, retention/renewal, protected role jobs, promotion approval and credentials remain to integrate.
No physical device bootstrap, installation or recovery result is claimed.
next_work: Pin external Yocto layer revisions and record toolchain/config/source provenance in a real OTA candidate build.
Wire the unprivileged build/qualification and origin checks into isolated protected signing and serialized delivery jobs.
